note: v1 89.17 (seeds 0/11 89.17/89.19), first draft of MATH-ROCK INTERPLAY, 'Floor 31': an office tower at night with every light left on, the building's machinery as music, ~7:05 in six movements at 132 bpm. A seven-note tapped FIGURE (D-F-A-C-A-F-E) is re-cut by every meter it passes through - 5/4 lobby, 7/8 interlock, 6/8 stairwell, 5/4 atrium, 7/8 machine squaring into 4/4, 4/4 roof - and a second guitar plays 4/4 phrases against the first's 7/8, the two realigning only every seven bars (compscore's polymeter: 100). The lift is the speech: a chime and an announcement voice calling floors between phrases ('going up, floor thirty one', 'doors closing', and at the very end, far below the roof, 'ground floor'); a clock ticks in the quiet movements. The machine brings two chug rigs on the 2+2+3, and the roof resolves to F major with the e-bow and wind. Levels 100 (-16.6 LUFS, dynamic, TP -2.1).
